note: Every clip starts AND ends on the home pose (image + last_frame_image), so any clip can follow any other without a jump.
common: Locked-off static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cut. A cute 3D cartoon puppy with golden fur and a blue bandana with a yellow star sits on a perfectly flat, plain, evenly lit pure green chroma-key background. No shadow on the background, no other objects, no text, no sparkles. The puppy keeps the same size and stays sitting in the same spot, paws stay planted.

clips.prompt: The puppy breathes calmly, blinks once slowly, and one ear twitches a little. Very subtle, calm, natural movement.
The puppy notices someone in front of it, perks up its ears, lifts one front paw and waves it once in greeting, then puts the paw back down and settles.
The puppy turns its head to look at something on the left side of the frame with curiosity, holds the look for a moment, then turns back to face forward.
The puppy turns its head to look at something on the right side of the frame with curiosity, holds the look for a moment, then turns back to face forward.
The puppy tilts its head to one side curiously, like it is listening to something interesting, then straightens up again.

Small, gentle motion only. The puppy stays sitting with all four paws on the ground. It closes its eyes in a big happy smile, its ears lift and bounce a little, its tail wags, and it gives a small proud wiggle of the shoulders. No jumping, no standing, no leaving the spot.
clips.note: A jump made the model melt the anatomy (draft test); the hop is done in code on top of this seated clip.

clips.prompt: The puppy speaks to the viewer, like a friendly teacher explaining something: its mouth clearly opens and closes in a talking rhythm, eyes open and looking at the viewer, with small head nods. It does not stand up.
The puppy looks toward the right side of the frame and lifts one front paw a little toward it, as if saying 'look over there', then looks back at the viewer and puts the paw down.
The puppy gives a gentle, kind, encouraging look: soft eyes, a small slow nod and a warm smile.
The puppy gets sleepy: a slow yawn, its eyes close for a moment, then it blinks awake and smiles again.
